description: This file defines the UserService class which provides user management functionalities such as saving users, retrieving users, deleting users, role management, password verification, and related utility methods within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Provides user management functionalities such as saving, retrieving, deleting users, role retrieval, password validation, and utility operations within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: geUserDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of UserDao, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: setUserDao
methods.description: Sets the UserDao instance used by the service.

methods.name: getPasswordHasher
methods.description: Returns an instance of PasswordHash, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: setPasswordHasher
methods.description: Sets the PasswordHash instance used by the service.

methods.name: saveSystemUser
methods.description: Saves a User object to the system, handling password hashing and demo mode restrictions.

methods.name: deleteSystemUsers
methods.description: Performs a soft deletion of users given their IDs.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves a UserRole by role name.

methods.name: getSearchSystemUsersCount
methods.description: Returns the count of users matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: searchSystemUsers
methods.description: Searches for users based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: isCurrentPassword
methods.description: Checks if the provided password matches the user's current password.

methods.name: getEmployeesByUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves employees associated with a specific user role, with options to include inactive or terminated employees.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Validates user credentials and returns the associated User if authentication succeeds.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: Hashes a password for secure storage.

methods.name: checkPasswordHash
methods.description: Verifies if a password matches a stored hash.

methods.name: checkForOldHash
methods.description: Checks for hash matches using older hashing methods (MD5).

methods.name: getUndeletableUserIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of users who cannot be deleted, including the current user and default admin in demo mode.
